title: Audio Denoising (Prototype; in progress!)
description: FPGA-based audio denoiser. I designed Verilog modules for the Discrete Wavelet Transform, specificically the lifting scheme, to separate out and threshold high-frequency coefficients of the input signal. A sigma-delta output is smoothed by an RC filter and transmitted via Bluetooth. I also soldered the components onto a perfboard.

title: Hill Cipher 2x2 Encoder/Decoder ASIC (Beaver Works Summer Institute Capstone)
description: Application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) that encodes and decodes a 2x2 hill cipher. Group project with Joyce Xu, Brian Chen, and Minseo (Elle) Kim as part of BWSI's Basics of ASICs course. I helped to design the overall scheme and also the inverse or decoding section. This will be taped out as a real chip through TinyTapeout!

title: "Lock-in" Box
description: A phone box submitted for the IEEE SSCS Arduino Contest's prompt "Solutions to Everyday Challenges". The box is locked by a servo for a time selected by a user using the buttons. A reed switch circuit checks for tampering, and an IMU detects phone vibration to unlock the box (i.e. for emergencies). Version 2 features a much better design with a custom PCB and new box parts modeled in Onshape.

title: Science Olympiad Electric Vehicle
description: My first experience with electronics! I participated in the Electric Vehicle event of Science Olympiad, where I was responsible for finding and putting together the electronic parts and programming the robot. This was done from scratch and on a relatively low level. Learned a ton about Arduino, PID, how to solder, motor selection, etc.
